name: Foulard
description: A foulard tie print: small open diamonds, each holding a dot of another color, with a pin dot set between every four.

code.style: --rule: ( background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, var(--color5) 7%, transparent 7.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0, var(--color5) 7%, transparent 7.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 0 100%, var(--color5) 7%, transparent 7.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, var(--color5) 7%, transparent 7.5%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 22.0%, 78.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 78.0%, 22.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 22.0%, 38.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 62.0%, 62.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 38.0%, 38.0% 50.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 22.0%, 78.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 78.0%, 22.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 22.0%, 38.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 62.0%, 62.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 38.0%, 38.0% 50.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 45%; top: 45%; width: 10%; height: 10%; border-radius: 50%; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
